summary: Bug fix verification for Collaboratore user flow: 3 critical bugs tested - privacy modal loop, profile data persistence, and compensation modal scroll. All backend tests PASS (14/14). Frontend verification confirms fixes working.

minor.issue: Returns object with 'records' key instead of direct array. Frontend has minor error handling this format but doesn't break functionality.

integration_issues.issue: Console error 'filter is not a function' when loading records - API returns {records: []} but code expects direct array. Non-blocking issue.

action_items: MINOR: Update compensation.tsx loadData() to handle API response format {records: []} instead of direct array
critical_code_review_comments: ✅ privacy_accepted fix VERIFIED at profile.tsx line 176: isPrivacyAccepted now correctly reads data.privacy_accepted === true
✅ collaboratore_license_number fix VERIFIED at server.py lines 1431, 1483-1484: Field added to UserProfileUpdate model and handler
✅ ScrollView fix VERIFIED at compensation.tsx: Modal uses ScrollView with fixed buttons outside for proper scroll and button accessibility
NOTE: Playwright automation has difficulty with React Native Web TouchableOpacity clicks. Used API + localStorage injection approach for testing.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Collaboratore bug fixes verified: 1) Privacy modal no longer loops - isPrivacyAccepted reads from data.privacy_accepted, 2) Profile data persists correctly - tested first_name, last_name, phone, collaboratore_license_number, 3) Compensation signature modal scrollable with fixed buttons at bottom. User lara@test.com has privacy_accepted=true now after tests.

privacy_modal_loop.description: Privacy modal no longer appears in infinite loop. The isPrivacyAccepted variable now correctly reads data.privacy_accepted === true from backend response.
privacy_modal_loop.test_result: Profile page loads without modal appearing on every page load

profile_data_persistence.description: Personal data (first_name, last_name, phone) correctly persists after save via PATCH /api/auth/me
profile_data_persistence.test_result: 14/14 backend tests pass including update and persistence verification

collaboratore_license_number.description: collaboratore_license_number field now included in UserProfileUpdate model and properly handled in PATCH /api/auth/me

compensation_modal_scroll.description: Signature modal in compensation page uses ScrollView with modalButtonsFixed style - buttons (Annulla, Firma Quietanza) always visible and accessible
compensation_modal_scroll.test_result: Modal opens with scrollable content and fixed bottom buttons
